parrafo_1.es: Ferny Painting Solutions es un equipo de pintura residencial con base en Kendall. Trabajamos interiores, exteriores, gabinetes y reparación de drywall, de principio a fin.
parrafo_1.en: Ferny Painting Solutions is a residential painting crew based in Kendall. We handle interiors, exteriors, cabinets and drywall repair, start to finish.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas en Google repiten lo mismo: honestidad, puntualidad y un acabado sin manchas. Liam Coleman quedó encantado con cómo quedaron su cocina y pasillo, protegidos y respetando su horario.
parrafo_2.en: The reviews on Google keep saying the same thing: honesty, punctuality and a finish with no streaks. Liam Coleman could not be happier with how his kitchen and hallway turned out, furniture protected and done around his schedule.

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué espacio quieres pintar: interior, exterior o gabinetes.
texto.en: Tell us what you want painted: interior, exterior or cabinets.

texto.es: Revisamos el espacio y te damos un precio claro antes de empezar, sin compromiso.
texto.en: We look at the space and give you a clear price before starting, no obligation.

texto.es: Protegemos muebles y pisos, reparamos drywall si hace falta, y aplicamos el color con cuidado.
texto.en: We protect furniture and floors, repair drywall where needed, and apply the color with care.

texto.es: Limpiamos al terminar cada jornada. Acabado parejo, sin manchas, tal como se promete.
texto.en: We clean up at the end of every day. Even finish, no streaks, exactly as promised.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el espacio y el alcance. Llámanos y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the space and scope. Call us and we will give you a price, no obligation.

texto.es: Salas, cocinas, recámaras y pasillos, con muebles protegidos y líneas limpias en cada esquina.
texto.en: Living rooms, kitchens, bedrooms and hallways, with furniture protected and clean lines in every corner.

texto.es: Fachadas, estuco y molduras, listas para resistir el clima de Miami con un acabado parejo.
texto.en: Facades, stucco and trim, ready to hold up against Miami weather with an even finish.

texto.es: Renovamos gabinetes de cocina y baño sin el costo de reemplazarlos por completo.
texto.en: We refresh kitchen and bathroom cabinets without the cost of replacing them entirely.

texto.es: Hoyos, grietas y parches reparados antes de pintar, para que el resultado final quede perfecto.
texto.en: Holes, cracks and patches fixed before painting, so the final result looks flawless.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu proyecto? Llámanos igual, seguro lo cubrimos.
pie.en: Do not see your project listed? Call us anyway, we likely cover it.

items.quote: Our kitchen and hallway look completely refreshed after the team finished. They protected our furniture and worked around our schedule without any issues. The colors dried beautifully with no streaks. It feels like a new space. We couldn't be happier.

The painters helped us freshen up our living room and den. They took their time prepping the walls which helped the final finish look perfect. The colors pop beautifully now. Cleanup was done thoroughly after each day.
I recently hired Kevin for a house I just bought to paint and I must say, it's rare to find such honesty and quality work these days.
